scripts.text: You've actually been to Valhalla?! Wow, you've come a long way...

scripts.text: Well, in any case, we only accept Novices for job changes to the Merchant class. But I appreciate your interest in what we do.
scripts.translation: 总之，我们只接受初心者申请转职为商人。不过，还是谢谢你对我们这一行感兴趣。
